newsitem.title: UK: Howden unit wins Chinese tunnel contract.
newsitem.headline: Howden unit wins Chinese tunnel contract.

text.p: Construction and mining group Howden said on Wednesday its subsidiary Wirth GmbH has won a $60 million order to supply China with two boring machines, which will be used to drill an 18 kilometre mountain railway tunnel linking the country's Shaanxi and Sichuan provinces.

Howden's chief executive Johnny Johnsen said the order emphasised the importance of markets in China and South East Asia, where the group increased turnover by over 50 percent in the last financial year.
Delivery will take place in the latter part of 1997.
